name: What is the difference between a standard and premium finish package?
description: Standard packages offer quality, durable materials within a set budget, while premium packages provide high-end materials, custom options, and designer choices.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a standard and premium finish package?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard finish package includes quality, durable materials chosen for their aesthetic appeal and functionality within a set budget. This typically involves popular options for flooring, cabinetry, countertops, and fixtures. A premium finish package offers a wider selection of high-end materials, custom options, and designer choices. This can include hardwood flooring, quartz or granite countertops, custom-built cabinetry, and luxury bathroom fixtures, providing a more refined and personalized aesthetic. The premium package allows for greater customization and higher material quality.
